method: Visual inspection of complete PDF pages; targeted audit, not random precision sample.

checks: Blue blinking and flickering have distinct meanings.
Steady-red columns are empty in blue row; left LED-off column is a true vertical span.
Robot battery low: replace pulse coder batteries; do not turn off robot, otherwise remastering may be needed.
Normal indications, warnings and alarms appear on the same page and must retain their distinctions.
Touching the stylus produces a beep and red LED: expected result, not prerequisite.
Tool-probe and work-probe procedures are separate sequences.
Pressure Relief on page 6 is required before any troubleshooting procedure.
Requirement introduces the section on page 8 and applies to its continuation on page 9.
Oil slinger disc touching gear housing/oil pipe: Atlas Copco Service only.
Neighbouring rotor running untrue and blocked/defective oil pump: service plus immediate shutdown.
Cause/remedy positions must respect wrapped lines; raw visual line counts differ.
Right action column is genuinely merged across all five symptom rows.
Service escalation is conditional on having checked all recommended adjustments and persistence of the problem.
Immediate no-plug/no-switch-on warning in first row must not be made conditional on failure of previous checks.
Ten symptom rows refer to a numbered list with entries 1 through 40.
Overheating row refers to 41, which has no definition on the page.
Higher-than-rated and lower-than-rated total head are distinct entries 17 and 18.
No corrective actions are prescribed in this section.
